author: Dacha1K

title: Started good, but turned into a disappointment
body: General: Pretty nice user interface. Nice solution to log bad habits (they reduce you HP), nice tracker for everyday tasks, but they don’t “hit” your HP if not accomplished during the day, which felt a bit disappointing. Absolutely good implementation of to-dos! Love it! Pets: I didn’t get why you need them in the game and what’s the mechanic behind them? Will they die if not fed? Will they help you somehow on your path of improvements? Problems: I would continue use this app, BUT the it started crashing on login on the third day of usage. Sorry guys, I had to delete it. Bottom line: a nice habits/tasks gamification app I’d gladly use if it was more stable.
author: tevtonez
